item.title: 2027 年强基计划数学：代数变形
item.description:
例1.1

设xxx满足条件x3−1x3=85x^3-\frac{1}{x^3}=8\sqrt{5}x3−x31​=85​,则x2+1x2x^2+\frac{1}{x^2}x2+x21​的值为?

立方和差恒等式:

  • a3−b3=(a−b)(a2+ab+b2)=(a−b)3+3ab(a−b)a^3-b^3=(a-b)(a^2+ab+b^2)=(a-b)^3+3ab(a-b)a3−b3=(a−b)(a2+ab+b2)=(a−b)3+3ab(a−b)
  • a3+b3=(a+b)(a2−ab+b2)=(a+b)3−3ab(a+b)a^3+b^3=(a+b)(a^2-ab+b^2)=(a+b)^3-3ab(a+b)a3+b3=(a+b)(a2−ab+b2)=(a+b)3−3ab(a+b)

显然,这道题可以使用恒等式解决:

x3−1x3=85(x−1x)3+3(x−1x)=85[(x−1x)−5][(x−1x)2+5(x−1x)+8]=0\begin{gathered} x^3-\frac{1}{x^3}=8\sqrt{5}\\ (x-\frac{1}{x})^3+3(x-\frac{1}{x})=8\sqrt{5}\\ [(x-\frac{1}{x})-\sqrt{5}][(x-\frac{1}{x})^2+\sqrt{5}(x-\frac{1}{x})+8]=0 \end{gathered}x3−x31​=85​(x−x1​)3+3(x−x1​)=85​[(x−x1​)−5​][(x−x1​)2+5​(x−x1​)+8]=0​

对于第二个括号,Δ=5−32<0\Delta=5-32\lt0Δ=5−32<0

所以只能是:x−1x=5x-\frac{1}{x}=\sqrt{5}x−x1​=5​

于是x2+1x2=(x−1x)2+2=7x^2+\frac{1}{x^2}=(x-\frac{1}{x})^2+2=7x2+x21​=(x−x1​)2+2=7

例1.2

已知在实数范围内:x+y=u+v,x2+y2=u2+v2x+y=u+v,x^2+y^2=u^2+v^2x+y=u+v,x2+y2=u2+v2,求证:xn+yn=un+vnx^n+y^n=u^n+v^nxn+yn=un+vn

可以发现,条件相当于两个质量相同的物体发生弹性碰撞,速度交换(其实也可以各自保持原先的速度).

目标:{x,y}={u,v}\{x,y\}=\{u,v\}{x,y}={u,v}

x+y=u+vx2+y2+2xy=u2+v2+2uv{x+y=u+v,xy=uv\begin{gathered} x+y=u+v\\ x^2+y^2+2xy=u^2+v^2+2uv\\ \begin{cases} x+y=u+v,\\ xy=uv \end{cases} \end{gathered}x+y=u+vx2+y2+2xy=u2+v2+2uv{x+y=u+v,xy=uv​​

所以,{x,y},{u,v}\{x,y\},\{u,v\}{x,y},{u,v}是同一个一元二次方程的两根,目标证毕.

例1.3

(北大)已知x≠yx\neq yx=y,且x2=2y+5,y2=2x+5x^2=2y+5,y^2=2x+5x2=2y+5,y2=2x+5,则x3−2x2y2+y3=?x^3-2x^2y^2+y^3=?x3−2x2y2+y3=?

x2−y2=2(y−x)x+y=−2x3+y3−2x2y2=(x+y)3−3xy(x+y)−2x2y2=6xy−2x2y2−8x2y2=(2x+5)(2y+5)(∗)x2y2−4xy−10(x+y)−25=0x2y2−4xy−5=0xy=−1,xy=5x3+y3−2x2y2=6×5−2×52−8=−28x3+y3−2x2y2=6×(−1)−2×(−1)2−8=−16\begin{gathered} x^2-y^2=2(y-x)\\ x+y=-2\\ x^3+y^3-2x^2y^2=(x+y)^3-3xy(x+y)-2x^2y^2\\ =6xy-2x^2y^2-8\\ x^2y^2=(2x+5)(2y+5)(*)\\ x^2y^2-4xy-10(x+y)-25=0\\ x^2y^2-4xy-5=0\\ xy=-1,xy=5\\ x^3+y^3-2x^2y^2=6\times5-2\times5^2-8=-28\\ x^3+y^3-2x^2y^2=6\times(-1)-2\times(-1)^2-8=-16 \end{gathered}x2−y2=2(y−x)x+y=−2x3+y3−2x2y2=(x+y)3−3xy(x+y)−2x2y2=6xy−2x2y2−8x2y2=(2x+5)(2y+5)(∗)x2y2−4xy−10(x+y)−25=0x2y2−4xy−5=0xy=−1,xy=5x3+y3−2x2y2=6×5−2×52−8=−28x3+y3−2x2y2=6×(−1)−2×(−1)2−8=−16​

很不幸,上述的解法看似巧妙,但是导致了增根,原因在于(*)变形不恒等.

x2=2(−x−2)+5x2+2x−1=0y2+2y−1=0(y≠x){xy=−1,x+y=−2\begin{gathered} x^2=2(-x-2)+5\\ x^2+2x-1=0\\ y^2+2y-1=0(y\ne x)\\ \begin{cases} xy=-1,\\ x+y=-2 \end{cases} \end{gathered}x2=2(−x−2)+5x2+2x−1=0y2+2y−1=0(y=x){xy=−1,x+y=−2​​

所以,只有−16-16−16是可行的答案.

例1.5

(2017北京大学自主招生)实数a,ba,ba,b满足(a2+4)(b2+1)=5(2ab−1)(a^2+4)(b^2+1)=5(2ab-1)(a2+4)(b2+1)=5(2ab−1),求b(a+1a)b(a+\frac{1}{a})b(a+a1​)的值.

贸然求解不可行,先尝试韦达定理或者均值不等式的取等条件:

(ab)2+(a2+4b2)+9−10ab=0≥(ab)2−6ab+9=(ab−3)2(ab)^2+(a^2+4b^2)+9-10ab=0\ge(ab)^2-6ab+9=(ab-3)^2(ab)2+(a2+4b2)+9−10ab=0≥(ab)2−6ab+9=(ab−3)2

于是得到{ab=3,ba=12\begin{cases}ab=3,\frac{b}{a}=\frac{1}{2}\end{cases}{ab=3,ab​=21​​

所以:b(a+1a)=72b(a+\frac{1}{a})=\frac{7}{2}b(a+a1​)=27​

事实上,更自然的方法是主元法:

(b2+1)a2−(10b)a+4b2+9=0Δ=(10b)2−4(b2+1)(4b2+9)=−16b4+48b2−36=−16(b2−32)2≥0b2=32a=5bb2+1=2bb(a+1a)=2b2+12=72\begin{gathered} (b^2+1)a^2-(10b)a+4b^2+9=0\\ \Delta=(10b)^2-4(b^2+1)(4b^2+9)\\ =-16b^4+48b^2-36\\ =-16(b^2-\frac{3}{2})^2\ge0\\ b^2=\frac{3}{2}\\ a=\frac{5b}{b^2+1}=2b\\ b(a+\frac{1}{a})=2b^2+\frac{1}{2}=\frac{7}{2} \end{gathered}(b2+1)a2−(10b)a+4b2+9=0Δ=(10b)2−4(b2+1)(4b2+9)=−16b4+48b2−36=−16(b2−23​)2≥0b2=23​a=b2+15b​=2bb(a+a1​)=2b2+21​=27​​

例1.6

已知a,b∈Q,a5+b5=2a2b2a,b\in Q,a^5+b^5=2a^2b^2a,b∈Q,a5+b5=2a2b2,求证:1−ab1-ab1−ab是有理数的平方.

1−ab=(a5+b52a2b2)2−ab=(a5+b5)2−4a5b54a4b4=(a5−b5)24a4b4=(a5−b52a2b2)2\begin{gathered} 1-ab=(\frac{a^5+b^5}{2a^2b^2})^2-ab\\ =\frac{(a^5+b^5)^2-4a^5b^5}{4a^4b^4}\\ =\frac{(a^5-b^5)^2}{4a^4b^4}\\ =(\frac{a^5-b^5}{2a^2b^2})^2 \end{gathered}1−ab=(2a2b2a5+b5​)2−ab=4a4b4(a5+b5)2−4a5b5​=4a4b4(a5−b5)2​=(2a2b2a5−b5​)2​

例1.7

(2015北京大学博雅计划)整数x,y,zx,y,zx,y,z满足xy+yz+zx=1xy+yz+zx=1xy+yz+zx=1,则(1+x2)(1+y2)(1+z2)(1+x^2)(1+y^2)(1+z^2)(1+x2)(1+y2)(1+z2)可能取到的值为

A. 16900 B. 17900 C. 18900 D. 前三个答案都不对

故技重施,常量代换:

1+x2=xy+yz+zx+x2=(x+y)(x+z)1+y2=(y+z)(y+x)1+z2=(z+x)(z+y)(1+x2)(1+y2)(1+z2)=[(x+y)(y+z)(z+x)]2\begin{gathered} 1+x^2=xy+yz+zx+x^2=(x+y)(x+z)\\ 1+y^2=(y+z)(y+x)\\ 1+z^2=(z+x)(z+y)\\ (1+x^2)(1+y^2)(1+z^2)\\ =[(x+y)(y+z)(z+x)]^2 \end{gathered}1+x2=xy+yz+zx+x2=(x+y)(x+z)1+y2=(y+z)(y+x)1+z2=(z+x)(z+y)(1+x2)(1+y2)(1+z2)=[(x+y)(y+z)(z+x)]2​

所以要求结果为完全平方数,故排除BC. 只需要找出可行的A.

130=2×5×13130=2\times5\times13130=2×5×13

令{x+y=2,y+z=5,z+x=13\begin{cases} x+y=2,\\ y+z=5,\\ z+x=13 \end{cases}⎩⎨⎧​x+y=2,y+z=5,z+x=13​,解得:{x=5,y=−3,z=8\begin{cases} x=5,\\ y=-3,\\ z=8 \end{cases}⎩⎨⎧​x=5,y=−3,z=8​

经检验,符合条件,故选A.

例1.9

联想到余弦定理,条件相当于A+B+C=π,cos⁡A+cos⁡B+cos⁡C=1A+B+C=\pi,\cos A+\cos B+\cos C=1A+B+C=π,cosA+cosB+cosC=1.

熟知cos⁡A+cos⁡B+cos⁡C=1+4sin⁡A2sin⁡B2sin⁡C2\cos A+\cos B+\cos C=1+4\sin\frac{A}{2}\sin\frac{B}{2}\sin\frac{C}{2}cosA+cosB+cosC=1+4sin2A​sin2B​sin2C​

所以有一个角的半角正弦值为0,这个角余弦值一定为1.

不妨设x=1,y=−zx=1,y=-zx=1,y=−z,则x2015+y2015+z2015=1x^{2015}+y^{2015}+z^{2015}=1x2015+y2015+z2015=1

或者考虑因式分解:

这是一个三元三次对称式,当a=b+ca=b+ca=b+c时,左式等于0,所以可以因式分解为:

(a+b−c)(b+c−a)(c+a−b)=0(a+b-c)(b+c-a)(c+a-b)=0(a+b−c)(b+c−a)(c+a−b)=0
